admin.heading: Audex
admin.help_block: Audex lets you manage script blocks — advertising, analytics, widgets, any HTML/JS. Each block is injected into the page on the server and completely omitted for excluded users and group members, so the code is never even loaded in their browser.
admin.scripts_section_help: Paste the full snippet exactly as provided, including its script tags. Blocks marked "head" are placed inside the page head; blocks marked "foot" are placed before the closing body tag.
admin.empty: No script blocks yet. Click "Add block" to create one.
admin.name_help: A short internal label. Angle brackets and double dashes are not allowed.
admin.position_help: head — inside the page head. foot — before the closing body tag. widget — rendered by the forum-widgets-core widget; its zone is configured in the widget editor.
admin.badge_widget_off_help: forum-widgets-core is disabled — this block is not rendered anywhere until it is enabled again.
admin.badge_head_help: The code is inserted into the page head on the server.
admin.badge_body_help: The code is inserted before the closing body tag on the server.
admin.badge_widget_help: The code is rendered by the Audex widget (forum-widgets-core); its zone is configured in the widget editor.
admin.enabled_switch_help: Toggle to turn this block on or off.
admin.code_help: Pasted into the page verbatim. If the code contains no script tag, it is treated as plain JavaScript and wrapped into one automatically. Inside JavaScript strings, escape the closing script tag with a backslash before the slash.
admin.exclusions_section_help: Users listed here and members of the selected groups will not receive any scripts at all. Exclusions never apply to guests.
admin.groups_help: Members of these groups will not receive scripts.
admin.users_help: These specific users will not receive scripts regardless of their groups.
admin.confirm_delete: Delete block "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
admin.error_json: The setting value is not valid JSON.
admin.error_too_many: Too many script blocks — the limit is {count}.
admin.error_name: Block {block}: the name must be a string of up to 100 characters.
admin.error_name_html: Block {block}: the name must not contain angle brackets or double dashes.
admin.error_code_empty: Block {block}: the code must not be empty.
admin.error_code_too_long: Block {block}: the code exceeds the limit of {max} bytes.
admin.error_position: Block {block}: the placement must be "head" or "foot".
admin.error_enabled: Block {block}: "enabled" must be true or false.

excluded_users.error_too_many: Too many excluded users — the limit is 1000.

excluded_groups.error_too_many: Too many excluded groups — the limit is 1000.

admin.request_error: Could not save the settings. Please check the input and try again.
